differences.title: 1. CONSISTENCY MODEL
differences.leftDesc: TiDB achieves strong consistency through its distributed consensus protocol (Raft) across its TiKV nodes, ensuring all transactions see the latest committed data.
differences.rightDesc: CockroachDB uses Raft for distributed transactions and replication, guaranteeing serializability and offering strong consistency across its geographically distributed data.

differences.title: 2. DATA MODEL
differences.leftDesc: TiDB stores data in row-oriented fashion within TiKV, optimized for transactional workloads and efficient retrieval of entire records.
differences.rightDesc: CockroachDB also employs a row-oriented storage model, beneficial for OLTP workloads where full rows are frequently accessed.

differences.title: 3. QUERY PROCESSING
differences.leftDesc: TiDB features a stateless distributed SQL layer (TiDB Server) that parses, optimizes, and coordinates queries across TiKV.
differences.rightDesc: CockroachDB's query layer is also distributed and stateless, handling query parsing, planning, and execution across its nodes.

differences.title: 4. TRANSACTION MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: TiDB uses Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) within TiKV to handle concurrent transactions, preventing read/write conflicts.
differences.rightDesc: CockroachDB utilizes MVCC to manage concurrent transactions, enabling high throughput and predictable performance for complex operations.

differences.title: 5. CLUSTERING & SCALING
differences.leftDesc: TiDB separates the SQL layer (TiDB Servers) from the storage layer (TiKV and PD), allowing independent scaling of compute and storage.
differences.rightDesc: CockroachDB nodes are unified and can independently serve SQL queries and store data, simplifying cluster management.

differences.title: 6. COMPATIBILITY FOCUS
differences.leftDesc: TiDB is designed for high compatibility with the MySQL protocol and SQL syntax, easing migration from existing MySQL applications.
differences.rightDesc: CockroachDB offers compatibility with the PostgreSQL wire protocol and a subset of its SQL syntax, attracting PostgreSQL users.

differences.title: 7. DISTRIBUTED COORDINATION
differences.leftDesc: TiDB relies on the Placement Driver (PD) for metadata management, region scheduling, and balance load across TiKV.
differences.rightDesc: CockroachDB integrates Raft directly within its storage engine for data replication and consensus, reducing external dependencies.
